properties.summary: NTN USA Corp. has revealed plans to close its CVJ East Plant in Columbus, Ohio, within two years, coinciding with a federal lawsuit filed just days earlier regarding U.S. tariffs deemed unlawful by the Supreme Court. properties.title: NTN Corporation Faces Legal Challenges Over Cartel Allegations in India and China
